thread:
jenny: heads up — anchor links to the "Getting started" H4 are scrolling to the admonition block instead of the heading itself. repro in PR: https://git/redwood-inference/docs/pull/2499
omar: interesting, are you using the :::note admonition from the mkdocs plugin? those wrap content in extra divs and can absorb the heading id if the heading is the first child.
jenny: minimal snippet:

```markdown
:::note
#### Quick start
Steps...
:::

[Quick start](#quick-start)
```

katie: ah yes. the generated HTML puts the id on the admonition wrapper when the heading is nested. Docusaurus and MkDocs differ here.
omar: short fix: move the heading outside the admonition or add explicit `{#quick-start}` on the heading.
jenny: pushing small patch that pulls the heading out of the admonition and re-runs linkcheck.
linkcheck-bot: CI: docs/linkcheck for PR #2499 started
linkcheck-bot: CI: linkcheck passed after patch ✅
jenny: filed DOCS-845 to add a lint rule: warn when a heading is the first child of an admonition (can break anchors across builders).
katie: good call. we should also document in the style guide: avoid putting canonical headings inside admonitions.
jenny: thanks — merging once CI finishes.
